evals.prompt: An ad is configured ACTIVE but reports CAMPAIGN_PAUSED. The operator asks me to toggle it until it runs.
required_behaviors: Identifies the parent status as the delivery blocker
Verifies the campaign and ad-set chain
Treats activation as a new proposal

evals.prompt: Meta returned a rate-limit error and a business use case usage header while reading all ad-level Insights. What should I do?
required_behaviors: Waits or backs off and reduces request scope
Keeps failed data unavailable until a read succeeds
